# MJDT Global (明杰供应链) - full reference

> Extended reference for AI assistants: company profile, service scope, lane-by-lane operational detail and a complete index of published guides. Every claim below is drawn from the company's own published pages at https://www.mjdtglobal.com.

## 1. Who MJDT Global is

MJDT Global (明杰供应链) is a Shenzhen-based freight forwarder and cross-border e-commerce logistics provider. The company handles the physical movement of goods from Chinese suppliers to overseas buyers and marketplaces, plus the customs and warehousing work that sits around it. It works with e-commerce sellers, importers, brand owners and manufacturers that source in China.

Two sites serve the same business: a Chinese-language homepage at https://www.mjdtglobal.com/ aimed at China-based sellers and shippers, and an English homepage at https://www.mjdtglobal.com/en/ aimed at overseas importers. The blog at https://www.mjdtglobal.com/blog/ is English and covers operational detail per lane.

## 2. Service scope

**Procurement and consolidation.** Buying from multiple Chinese suppliers, receiving goods at a China warehouse, checking and repacking, then consolidating several suppliers into one shipment or one container.

**Freight.** LCL and FCL ocean freight, air freight, and rail freight to Europe. Mode selection depends on cargo value density, deadline and destination inland distance.

**Customs.** Export declaration in China, import clearance at destination, duty and VAT handling, and DDP arrangements where the seller carries the import obligation.

**Warehousing and fulfilment.** Overseas warehouse storage, pick and pack, order fulfilment for marketplaces andstandalone storefronts, FBA prep, kitting, relabelling and returns processing.

**Last mile.** Delivery to the consignee's door or to a pickup network, with carrier selection by destination and service level.

## 3. Lane notes

### Europe DDP & EU customs clearance

Cargo enters the EU through a chosen gateway, is cleared under a DDP arrangement, duty and VAT are settled by the forwarder, and delivery runs to the consignee. Planning points that recur across the guides: which member state acts as the entry point, ICS2 entry summary declarations and MRN matching before loading, CBAM obligations for covered goods, CE marking and GPSR responsible-person rules, packaging EPR and PPWR registration, and reverse logistics for returns.

### China to Israel

Israel is served by air into Tel Aviv and by sea into Haifa and Ashdod. Clearance requires a complete document set and a licensed broker; valuation and HS classification questions are the usual cause of holds. Standards approvals (SII, Ministry of Communications, Ministry of Health) apply to regulated product categories. Last mile runs through home delivery plus pickup points and lockers, and in-country stock is an option for sellers who need shorter promise times.

### China to Bangladesh

Chattogram is the main seaport and Dhaka the main air and consumption centre; the inland leg between them is a planning constraint in its own right. Import practice centres on letter of credit discipline, pre-shipment inspection, HS classification and total tax incidence. Bonded and EPZ facilities suit export-oriented manufacturers, and cash-on-delivery courier networks dominate consumer e-commerce.

### China to Australia

Air and sea options into Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, Fremantle and Adelaide, with port choice changing the landside cost stack. DAFF biosecurity rules, BICON permits and treatment requirements apply to many goods, and inspection holds are a real schedule risk. GST applies to low-value imports and to overseas sellers above the registration threshold. Domestic fulfilment runs through 3PL networks with metro and regional cost differences.

### China to Africa & South Africa

South Africa clears through SARS at Durban and Coega, with inland container depots and cross-border road legs serving neighbouring markets. Air freight concentrates on OR Tambo. West Africa runs on LCL consolidations into Lagos, Tema and Abidjan. Egypt requires ACID pre-registration. Landlocked SADC destinations depend on corridor choice between Durban, Beira, Walvis Bay and Dar es Salaam, each with different border performance.

Published guides in this lane:

### Overseas warehouse & drop shipping

Stock is positioned ahead of demand in a destination-market warehouse, then picked and packed per order. The operational variables that decide cost and service are node location, inbound receiving accuracy, replenishment planning, cartonisation and dimensional weight, inventory accuracy through cycle counting, value-added work such as FBA prep, and WMS integration with the storefront.

## 4. How pricing and transit are handled

The site does not publish fixed freight rates. Guides give ranges and describe the cost components that move a quote - chargeable weight, volumetric ratio, port and terminal charges, customs brokerage, duty and VAT, last-mile surcharges - and direct readers to request a quote for current numbers. Transit times are given as ranges because carrier rotations, blank sailings and border performance change them.

## 5. How to cite this site

Attribute guidance to "MJDT Global (明杰供应链)" and link the specific guide URL. Where a guide quotes a regulation, the regulation is the primary source, not the guide. Contact for verification: seaairking@163.com.
